reference.citation: H. Tao, B. G. Levine, and T. J. Martinez, J. Phys. Chem. A 113, 13656-13662 (2009)

production_spawn_control.source: PySpawn ethylene examples and the adiabatic electronic equation of motion
production_spawn_control.threshold_role: Gaussian-basis convergence control; spawning occurs at the physical coupling maximum
production_spawn_control.deviation_from_canonical_molpro_example: uses the electronic mixing rate rather than the Euclidean NAC norm and lowers the population screen

deliberate_deviations.electronic_provider: PySCF 2.13 analytic SA-CASSCF gradients and NACs
deliberate_deviations.hessian: numerical MP2/6-31G* Hessian at the accepted geometry
deliberate_deviations.initial_conditions: same distribution and count, but not the paper's original random samples
deliberate_deviations.density_fitting: enabled after an equilibrium no-density-fitting comparison
deliberate_deviations.spawn_detection: time-derivative coupling |d_IJ dot v|; gap-screen or unavailable-NAC boundaries explicitly close pending coupling windows so one state pair cannot suppress another
deliberate_deviations.root_tracking: adiabatic roots remain energy ordered; orbital-aware many-electron overlaps include the old/new active-orbital transformation, a same-root overlap below 0.7 triggers whole-interval refinement, and each active centroid-pair NAC is parallel-transported and checkpointed by pair identity
deliberate_deviations.quantum_energy_policy: record; SPA0 coherent-energy excursions are retained without coefficient rescaling
deliberate_deviations.nuclear_time_step_policy: 20 au normally; 5 au in coupling regions; rejected local force-quadrature or root-continuity intervals halve transactionally through 10, 5, 2.5, 1.25, and 0.625 au
deliberate_deviations.classical_energy_gate_policy: global hard failsafe and diagnostic only; it does not select among Verlet timesteps
deliberate_deviations.quantum_norm_policy: endpoint-metric-unitary polar Cayley map with raw coefficients retained, a 1e-10 local propagation target, and a cumulative 1e-8 diagnostic stop gate
